tasks.title: Deploy Runtime Safety Guard (MU-Plugin)
tasks.description: Install tools/wp-seo-guard.php to wp-content/mu-plugins/ to prevent accidental noindex and canonical redirect loops.

tasks.title: Implement Connected Knowledge Graph (@graph)
tasks.description: Construct single connected JSON-LD graph linking WebSite, Organization, Author, and BreadcrumbList via canonical @id URIs.

tasks.title: Configure Dynamic wp_robots Directives
tasks.description: Implement max-snippet:-1, max-image-preview:large, max-video-preview:-1 while safeguarding is_front_page() against noindex.

tasks.title: Normalize Canonical URLs Across Pagination & Taxonomies
tasks.description: Ensure self-referential HTTPS canonicals, trailing-slash normalization, and pagination handling on archive templates.

tasks.title: Implement LCP Resource Preload & Font-Display Swap
tasks.description: Hook into wp_head to inject fetchpriority='high' and link rel='preload' for above-the-fold hero image and primary web fonts.

tasks.title: End-to-End Harness Audit & Final Certification
tasks.description: Execute tools/audit-harness.sh and verify zero console errors, clean debug.log, and 100/100 harness rating.
